archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / TACTICAL MISSION CONTROL
design_freedom: HIGH - Tactical aerospace aesthetics, high-contrast control room UI, 3D Canvas flight & hangar rendering
theme: Dark Control Room (Deep Space Obsidian #07090E, Tactical Slate #0F172A, Glass Charcoal #1E293B)

typography.font_family_telemetry: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase

layout_and_panel_styles.header: Fixed top bar with mission time, telemetry status, active mission name, stage state, and nav tabs. Uses glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-950/80 border-b border-slate-800).
layout_and_panel_styles.bento_grid: Tight high-density tactical grid (gap-4 to gap-6). Cards have 1px crisp subtle border with soft inner shadow.
layout_and_panel_styles.hazard_buttons: Critical controls (Launch, Staging, Abort) have dual-step safety triggers, diagonal hazard stripes on hover or active state, and distinctive monospaced labels.
layout_and_panel_styles.telemetry_readouts: Dark inset boxes (bg-slate-950/90) with high contrast monospaced numeric values, unit labels (e.g. km, m/s, kN, kg, $M, m/s Δv), and status indicator dots.

threejs_and_3d.hangar: Three.js 3D Rocket Assembly viewport with orbit controls, interactive component highlight on hover, grid floor pattern, direction lights, metallic/composite part shaders, and live camera framing.
threejs_and_3d.flight_simulator: 3D Earth/Orbital space view with atmosphere glow shader, camera tracking modes (Rocket Chase, Orbit Top-Down, Ground Launch View, Cockpit Telemetry), velocity vectors, trajectory arc paths, and particle thruster plume effects.

screens.main_menu: Mission title banner, save file manager (create, load, duplicate, delete), quick play preset launcher, telemetry log stats.
screens.mission_planner: Template cards (First Orbit, LEO Telecom Satellite, Lunar Relay, Mars Sample Return), target orbit parameters, budget & mass limits, primary & secondary objectives.
screens.hangar_3d: Center 3D Rocket Canvas, Left: Part Catalog filterable by category (Command, Engines, Tanks, Aerodynamics, Utility), Right: Stage Manager & Drag-Drop/Reorder list + Part Inspector with mass, thrust, ISP, cost, and live delta-V calculation.
screens.readiness_review: Subsystem checks (Propulsion, Avionics, Thermal, Structural, Aerodynamics, Power). Expandable traceable calculation rows displaying inputs, formulas, physical units, sources, and final pass/warn/fail status with master GO / NO-GO toggle.
screens.engineering_advisor: Rules-based automated advisor providing real-time warning cards, optimization suggestions, TWR warnings, and stage efficiency tips.
screens.launch_flight: Full-screen 3D orbital space view, Flight HUD overlay (altitude, orbital speed, acceleration, throttle slider, RCS toggle, staging button, apoapsis/periapsis, pitch/yaw/roll gyro, guidance computer ascent profile graph, time warp x1-x1000).
screens.mission_results: Post-flight analysis breakdown: Mission Score, success/failure cause chain, telemetry charts (Altitude vs Time, Speed vs Time, Fuel vs Time), key event log with timestamps.

testing_attributes.rule: Every button, input, tab, telemetry value, panel, modal, and key indicator MUST have a clear data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure React JS + Three.js (@react-three/fiber or direct Three.js canvas setup in standard React components).
Ensure all components are in .js / .jsx format.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for text panels or overlays — always use backdrop-blur with semi-opaque dark slate fills.
Incorporate Sonner toasts for notifications (Part attached, Stage updated, Abort triggered, Telemetry warning).
Implement rules-based physics engine in JS for realistic Δv (Tsiolkovsky rocket equation), TWR, atmospheric drag, gravity acceleration, and orbital mechanics calculations.
Provide clear keyboard shortcuts (Space for launch/stage, X for throttle cut, Shift/Control for throttle up/down, 1-5 for time warp speeds).
